name: ASSET_VALUATION_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A code that describes why this valuation was done such as: - Required for risk management regulatory capital calculations - Appraisal

name: ATM_CHANNEL_TYPE

description: This entity defines which benefit plan options are available to a specific position. For example, full-time permanent positions may include different benefits than part-time or temporary positions may offer.

name: BILLBOARD_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: A type of CHANNEL INSTANCE that identifies communication through billboards. This represents a specific billboard.

name: BOND_ISSUE_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A code for the reason the issuer issued the bond such as research and development, roads, equipment, or cash backup.

name: BRANCH_SITE
description: This entity is a subtype of site, which is a physical branch.

name: CALL_CENTER_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This is a type of channel that is a call center.

name: CALL_CENTER_TERMINAL_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific call center terminal that is used as a channel.

name: CALL_CENTER_TYPE
description: This minor entity classifies the types of call center such as inbound, outbound, or inbound and outbound.

name: CAMPAIGN_CHANNEL_TYPE_MULTIMEDIA_OBJECT
description: This associative entity identifies those multimedia objects that are used for this campaign for this channel type. name: CAMPAIGN_OBJECTIVE_POSITION_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the positioning type used for the campaign.  Examples: - Guaranteed - Requested

name: CELL_TARGET_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity contains those channel instances that are the target of a marketing campaign cell.

name: CHANNEL_CAPACITY
description: This associative entity identifies the volume of transaction per unit of time and, by channel characteristics set by bank business rules.

description: This entity relates a CHANNEL CLASS VALUE with a CHANNEL INSTANCE. A CHANNEL INSTANCE can be classified many ways. name: CHANNEL_CLASS_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the schemes for classifying channels. Examples of schemes include proximity to business and daytime usage (e.g., high, medium, and low).

name: CHANNEL_CLASS_VALUE
description: For a given classification scheme these value codes represent the various values for a given classification scheme. name: CHANNEL_COST
description: This entity tracks allocated costs related to channels that cannot otherwise be derived from events and accounts.

name: CHANNEL_EVENT
description: This entity tracks the servicing and downtime for each channel that is susceptible to downtime.

name: CHANNEL_EVENT_REASON_TYPE
description: This minor entity defines the reason for the downtime of the financial institution equipment.

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity brings together all the specific touch points in the enterprise. It identifies all the specific channels that customers and other parties use to interact with the enterprise. One instance exists for each specific channel. For example, each ATM has its own ID; each point-of-sale terminal

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_RELATED
description: This entity relates one channel instance to another channel instance and describes the relationship between the two channel instances. This structure allows for both a hierarchical relationship and a network relationship between channel instances.

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_RELATED_REASON
description: A code for the role that one channel instance has with another channel instance such as "replaces," "is part of," or "contains."

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_SITE_XREF
description: This entity tracks the site of a channel instance over time.  Channels such as specific ATMs can move from site to site over time.

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the change to the status of a channel instance over time.  Status examples could be active, in development, on hold, no new campaigns, or closed for deletion.

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_SUBTYPE
description: A code for the subtype instance such as kiosk, electronic channel, call center terminal, party, radio station, print, television, and location.

name: CHANNEL_NETWORK
description: This associative entity describes those networks to which a channel has access. ATMs and point-of-sale devices have access to third-party networks for communication between the device and the financial institution.

name: CHANNEL_OPERATING_HOURS
description: This entity describes the operating hours for a channel. This structure allows for a channel to operate at different hours for different days. name: CHANNEL_PROCESSING_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the type of processing for a channel type for customer communications. It is specifically defined for the Teradata Relationship Management.  Examples: - 1 = use party channel link - 2 = allocate all parties to channel instance # 1

name: CHANNEL_PROFIT
description: This derived entity contains the profit for a channel and is derivable from channel costs (CHANNEL COST) and event revenues. Technically, it does not belong in the model but is here for those banks that cannot yet derive profit from the model.

name: CHANNEL_REPLENISHMENT
description: This entity identifies the quantity that was replenished when the channel ran out of its delivery product. Delivery products include anything returned to the customer such as cash, stamps, or tickets.

name: CHANNEL_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the status of the channel for purposes of using it for customer communications. Examples would be active, in development, on hold, no new campaigns, or closed for deletion.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This entity defines the major classifications of channels; consider, for example, call center, web site, and brick and mortar. name: CHANNEL_TYPE_CAPACITY
description: This associative entity identifies the volume of transaction per unit of time and, by channel type.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_GROUP
description: This entity is a grouping of channel types into higher levels. For example, a kiosk could be grouped into a self-service classification. A billboard could be grouped into a marketing classification.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_GROUP_XREF
description: This entity is the association of a channel type with a grouping of channel types. It allows for a channel type to belong to more than one group.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_SITE
description: This entity identifies the channel types related to a SITE. A SITE can have one type of channel that represents its main or major type of channel. This entity then identifies all other types of channels related to a SITE.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_STATUS
description: This is the status of the channel for purposes of using it for customer communications. Examples would be, active, in development, on hold, no new campaigns, or closed for deletion.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity is a subtype discriminator to CHANNEL TYPE. Examples include ATM, kiosk, and telephone.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_SURVEY_RESPONSE
description: This subentity identifies the channel type that is the subject of this survey question.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_USAGE
description: This entity identifies the ways this channel can be used such as for sales, marketing, fraud prevention, and general notification.

name: CHANNEL_USAGE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the ways a channel can be used such as: - Sales - Marketing - Fraud prevention - Information delivery

name: CURRENCY_POSITION_METRIC
description: This entity tracks metrics at the level of currency type for a given position - long or short. There is one instance for each type of currency (e.g., USD) for each type of position (long or short), for each type of metric and for each calculation scenario.  From this entity, the derived short and lo

name: DIRECT_MAIL_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This is a type of channel that is physical mail.

name: ELECTRONIC_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific electronic address (e.g., web site address, and email address) that is used as a channel instance.

name: EVENT_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This lists the channels that are involved with an event as specified by the event reason.

name: EVENT_CHANNEL_REASON
description: This is the reason a channel instance is involved with an event such as for sales, for marketing, for fraud prevention, or for taking a survey.

name: EXTERNAL_CLAIM_VEHICLE_DISPOSITION_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the status of the vehicle being claimed such as repaired, stolen, totaled, damaged, no compensation or other.

name: FINANCIAL_RULE_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A code that identifies why this rule exists such as regulatory compliance or guideline.

name: HR_POSITION
description: A HR POSITION that can be filled by an ASSOCIATE (e.g., manager, assistant manager, and sales clerk).  Specific functional role within an organization with defined job scope and responsibilities, usually identified by a job title and grade.

name: HR_POSITION_RELATED
description: Indicates a relationship between positions. For example, one position may serve as relief backup to another in case of absence.

name: HR_POSITION_RELATED_ROLE
description: Defines the role served by the related position. Sample values are relief and replacement.

name: HR_POSITION_SITE
description: This entity links human resource positions with sites such as the site(s) where these positions are valid or are filled.

name: HR_POSITION_SITE_REASON
description: This is a code for the reason the site is associated with the human resources position such as "is valid in" or "is filled in."

name: HR_POSITION_TRAIT
description: A generic construct to describe characteristics of an HR POSITION, for example, spending approval limit or stock purchase eligibility grade.

name: HR_POSITION_TYPE
description: The type of position that can be filled by an ASSOCIATE.  Examples: - Permanent full-time - Permanent part-time - Temporary full-time - Temporary part-time

name: INSTITUTIONAL_TREATMENT
description: Treatment plan information reported on an institutional claim.  Required when Home Health Agencies (HHA) need to report "Plan of Treatment" information under various payer contracts.

name: INVESTMENT_PORTFOLIO_POSITION_SUMMARY
description: This is a derived summary entity that reports the investment position by investment product and portfolio (agreement group). name: INVESTMENT_POSITION
description: This entity tracks the values of the investment over time for this holding. The values can include book value (as represented on the balance sheet), fair value, and market value. It gives a point-in-time position value for a holding in a financial instrument. The values could be actual or projected.

name: INVESTMENT_POSITION_SPECIFIC
description: This entity tracks the values of the investment over time for this holding. The values can include book value (as represented on the balance sheet), fair value, and market value. It gives a point-in-time position value for a holding in a financial instrument. The values can be actual or projected.

name: INVESTMENT_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A description of the purpose of this investment.  Examples: - Steady income for retirement - Maximize cash flow - Long-term - Short-term - College savings - Hedge another investment

name: IVR_ACTION
description: User interaction function performed in an IVR step. Determined by override process and implemented by the application entry. A function combines operational characteristics such as language.

name: IVR_LEG
description: An action performed within the Interactive Voice Response determined by a distinct call record. If the call is routed to a different call center or server then a new leg is created.

name: IVR_LEG_ACTION_TYPE
description: A code identifying the IVR action that started the IVR leg.

name: IVR_STEP_NAVIGATION
description: Processing segment of the call leg consisting of an interaction with the caller supported by a single action (override) begun with an entry into the application. name: IVR_TERMINATION_TYPE
description: Identifies the type of outcome at termination of the step or leg.

name: JOB_TITLE_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This entity contains channel types that are job titles. name: KIOSK_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific kiosk that is used as a channel instance.  If the kiosk is owned by your institution then it is also a fixed asset and will have a Fixed Asset Id.

name: LEDGER_POSTING_STATUS
description: The entity that indicates the posting status of a general/subledger batch.  Possible examples may be: - Posted (ready to be entered in the general/subledger) - Do not post

name: LIENHOLDER_POSITION_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the position that the lienholder has with the asset such as first, second, and primary.

name: LOCK_BOX_CHANNEL_INSTANCE

name: MEASUREMENT_EVENT_PURPOSE
description: This entity describes the purpose of the MEASUREMENT EVENT.  Examples: - Ensure product quality - Analyze equipment maintenance rates

name: METRIC_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: This is a code to describe the purpose of the metric. For example, a site that is a company building might measure physical characteristics such as square footage.

name: MODEL_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: Describes the purpose of the analytical model.  Examples: - Churn analysis - Growth analysis - Acquisition analysis - Defection analysis - Probability of default - Los given default

name: MODEL_RUN_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the purpose of the model run such as testing, training, ongoing maintenance, back testing, or forward prediction.

name: MORTALITY_TABLE_PURPOSE
description: This entity captures the reason why the mortality table is assigned to the individual such as for pricing, repricing, or for reserves.

description: This entity captures information regarding ads displayed on mobile applications.

description: This entity captures information regarding the specific types of online applications that are run by users.  Examples: - Media Player - Audio Player - Interactive set-top box application - Video game - Content reader - Content downloader

description: This entity captures information regarding the category classification of the application.  Examples: - Business - Educational - Leisure

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_COUNTRY_GROUP
description: This entity captures information that specifies the countries targeted by a specific online application program. Multiple countries can be served by the same online application program.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_DEVICE_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding devices the interactive application is supported on.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_GENRE
description: This entity captures information regarding the nature/subject matter of an online application program.  Examples: - Music related - Movie related - Education related - Games related  Note: This is a recursive structure, allowing a hierarchy of genres.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_METRIC
description: This entity captures information regarding application metrics experienced by the user. name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_PAGE_VIEW_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding online application programs displayed on a given web page.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_RATING
description: This entity captures information regarding specific rating (or certification) that can be assigned to an online application program.

description: This entity identifies the roles that can be filled when online application programs are related.

description: This entity captures information regarding the subcategory classification of the application.  Examples: - Commercial business - Higher educational - Young adult leisure

description: This entity captures information regarding online documents that do not have unique identification information. These types of documents usually are content provided by visitors to the company's web site. This also applies to social media sites where members share content.

description: This entity captures summary information regarding the online promotions associated with visitor session activities.

name: ONLINE_PROMOTION_TYPE
description: This code captures information regarding the various types of online promotions presented during a session.  Examples: - Upsale - Cross-sale - Free shipping - Buy 1 and get 1 free - % Off

name: ONLINE_PROMOTION_VISIT_XREF
description: This entity provides a cross-reference between online promotions and visitor sessions.

name: ONLINE_RADIO_STATION
description: This entity captures information regarding radio stations where playlist are experienced.

name: ONLINE_VISITOR_AFFILIATION_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the affiliations of web visitors.

name: OPPORTUNITY_PROPOSAL

name: PACKAGE_CHANNEL_LINEUP

name: TRADE_EXECUTION_OTC_POST-TRADE
description: This entity associates the trade execution with the over-the-counter post-trade indicators per the MiFID field 63 requirements. There can be more than one type of indicator for each trade execution.

name: TRADE_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: This code identifies the reason for the trade such as to hedge the risk created from another trade or investment, or to mitigate the risk of another position.

name: TREATMENT_TYPE
description: Identifies the plan of treatment. An example source could be treatment codes from CMS code set 359.

name: WEB_SITE_DATABASE_REPOSITORY
description: This entity contains information regarding the database repository for the web site.
